name: The Demon Seed
summary: Neeru Fireblade's orders reach Ak'Zeloth, and the orc sends Horde travelers against the Demon Seed atop Dreadmist Peak. A Flawed Power Stone can break the Burning Legion's conduit before its influence spreads farther through the Barrens.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Crags
sections.body: You carry an unstable Flawed Power Stone to a cave high on Dreadmist Peak. There, the Demon Seed hangs above an altar of fire. The artifact anchors the Burning Legion's demonic power in the heart of the Barrens. Ak'Zeloth prepared the stone to break its link to the Nether, but its energy will not last long.

sections.title: Shattering the Tether
sections.body: The Flawed Power Stone loses power as you cross Dreadmist Peak's craggy slopes. Set it against the altar of fire, and its force overloads the Demon Seed and shatters the artifact's connection. Powerful shockwaves pass through the ether. Unseen masters learn that their device has been compromised.

faq.answer: The Demon Seed is a Burning Legion artifact in a cavern atop Dreadmist Peak. It hangs above an altar of fire and draws demonic power and influence into the Barrens.

faq.q: Who orders the destruction of the Demon Seed?
faq.answer: Ak'Zeloth orders the Demon Seed destroyed, following instructions from Neeru Fireblade, a warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. Neeru also provides the rewards.

faq.q: Why does the Flawed Power Stone have a time limit?
faq.answer: Ak'Zeloth's Flawed Power Stone is unstable. Its imperfect magical containment lets its disruptive energy burn out, so it must reach the demonic altar quickly.

faq.q: Where is the altar of fire located?
faq.answer: The altar of fire lies in a cavern near the summit of Dreadmist Peak, northwest of the Crossroads in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: What happens when the Demon Seed is destroyed?
faq.answer: Destroying the Demon Seed severs its link to the Burning Legion, and the release sends immense ripples through the ether. Ak'Zeloth warns that powerful demonic entities will sense the disruption and investigate the ruin of their tool.

faq.q: How does this connect to Neeru Fireblade?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade coordinates with Ak'Zeloth against rival or disruptive demonic artifacts across the Barrens. Neeru supplies the coin and equipment given once the Demon Seed is destroyed.

angles.text: As a warlock, you recognize the delicate craft of power stones that disrupt Legion tethers without causing a catastrophic demonic implosion.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect the Barrens' vital caravan crossroads and the trade routes that sustain the young Horde by eliminating Legion footholds.
As an orc, you have endured Draenor's ruin under demonic corruption and have little tolerance for Legion altars near Durotar's borders.
